releaseTitle: Schedule Builder Delete Reliability and Delta Baseline Repair
notes: Repairs Schedule Builder Clear Month so it deletes every shift in the displayed month across canonical and legacy tenant identity fields through an authenticated server boundary.
Repairs individual shift deletion so one shift chip can be deleted reliably, including hidden duplicate records for the same employee/date/time.
Repairs failed+new delta selection so a completed full gate with zero failures is a valid baseline and version identity can be recovered from surviving full-run evidence.
The delta command now runs the current release targeted regressions before its scoped Playwright selection. Request Off cutoff/blackout behavior and unrelated application features are unchanged.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.25
summary: Repairs Schedule Builder shift deletion and restores useful failed+new delta testing from a clean full baseline.
description: Moves Schedule Builder destructive shift deletion behind an authenticated tenant-safe server operation and repairs delta baseline handling for clean full release-gate runs.
